mixVerdict: DRAFT_MIX_FOR_REVIEW: sixth scene mix after CIN_006 v1, CIN_003 v1, CIN_005 v1, CIN_007 v1 and CIN_008 v1, built with the P0 v3 recipe (same gain targets, ducking params, peak guard, loop joins). stemAssignment.source: No CP02 assignment exists for CIN_009; lam_trieu music + waterfall ambience are the forest-and-water cues (composed, CP26/CP30) for this forest-answers scene (S01: a stream between mossy tree roots, fireflies, DETAIL_LOCKED; S02: three villagers with baskets and axes on a forest path, WIDE_STATIC; S03: top-down waterfall and stream beside a shrine, bamboo and a dirt path; keyframes CIN_009 S01/S02/S03). lam_trieu is the composed set's G-major transposition with ornamented flute (Lam Trieu, forest tide) -- the flute carries the forest's answering voice of the scene title 'Tieng rung duoc dap'; waterfall is the water bed for the stream running through all three shots. and the reveal stinger is the scene's only manifest-listed candidate stem (CIN_009_timing_v1.json).
stemAssignment.alternateTakeExcluded: N/A: CIN_009 has no alternate take.

notes: VO window 12.5-17.5 s is PROPOSED_ANIMATIC_PLACEMENT (only CIN_001_S05 is DECIDED); all 21 windows are approved for DRAFT VO per Goi 30 D1.

VO take runs 12.5-16.580 s: 4.080 s, ending 0.920 s BEFORE the 17.5 s window end -- the take FITS inside its window (no overrun, unlike CIN_005/CIN_006). The take ends 1.420 s before the 18.00 s scene end, so no tail trim at the scene edge. The window, the take and the timing are unchanged.

The CP17 VO take is hot (-17.23 LUFS per checkpoint 17, vs -23.10 LUFS for the CIN_008 take): the mix is hotter than CIN_008 for that reason alone, as CIN_007 was hotter than its neighbours for the same reason. VO is kept at unity per the recipe, not normalized.

Ducking depth is measured on the ducked bus against its unducked render (RMS over the full VO window vs a 2 s reference before the window). The full-window method from checkpoint 39 is retained so the depth is comparable across the CIN_003/CIN_005/CIN_007/CIN_008/ CIN_009 mixes (a 2 s slice can understate the cut on cues whose window opening is quiet).
Ambience loop join uses a 1 s acrossfade; loopQA reports the max sample jump at the join against the bed's own 99.9th-percentile jump.
Stinger placement at 6.0 s (S02 start) is PROPOSED pending picture lock, mirroring the CIN_004 reveal at 6.0 s.
